resolution.note: fast selects test/adopt/canary.test.ts on src/adopt/canary.ts change: CLI route map parsed, cli/main.ts spawn recognised; test in test/fast-check.test.ts

title: npm run fast selects the canary test when the adopt canary changes
body:
Why: lane bootstrap-adopt (#832): changing src/adopt/canary.ts and src/cli/adopt.ts, npm run fast (in ship) passed but CI failed on test/adopt/canary.test.ts, which asserts the old behaviour; fast did not select it (two red Checks).
Outcome: fast selects every test that imports or spawns a changed module (including tests that run bin/krn adopt), so the canary test runs on a canary.ts change.
Proof: a fast-check test: changing src/adopt/canary.ts selects test/adopt/canary.test.ts.
